description: This is a C# Entity Framework Core migration class defining the creation of a 'Customers' table with various columns and an index, as well as the method to drop the table during rollback.

classes.name: InitialCreate
classes.description: A Migration class defining the schema change for creating the 'Customers' table.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the operations to apply the migration: creating the 'Customers' table with specified columns and an index.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Defines the operations to revert the migration: dropping the 'Customers' table.
